properties.evidence: Drawn from the CAUSE to the record of the SYMPTOM. The guard's membership was drawn on `add_*` call names rather than on the behaviour it polices, so link_artifact was never tested for the class and its half-fix went unnoticed from BL-166 until a caller tripped over the friction on 2026-09-07. The test evidence is the negative control: restoring the unconditional write fails exactly one case, and that case did not exist in the guard until this change.
